spec.problem: People know their Human Design type but say 'On the days I actually am able to follow my Strategy and Authority... I feel more aligned and notice way less bitterness. The problem is I keep forgetting.' They can name their Authority but don't run it against real daily decisions, and the apps they've tried are broken or only in English.
spec.buyer: Hebrew-speaking Human Design fans in Israel, mostly in HumandesignIsrael Facebook group and Israeli HD WhatsApp groups, who know their type but don't apply Strategy and Authority day to day.
jobs: Get one Hebrew reminder each morning that names today's Authority action in plain words
Get one real decision to test the Authority on that day
Not have to open an app or re-learn HD theory every morning
scopeIn: One-time WhatsApp intake form for birth date, time, place
Daily 7am WhatsApp message: type + Strategy line + today's Authority tip + one decision prompt
Manual Gumroad checkout, manual WhatsApp group add (v1 not self-serve automated billing gate)
scopeOut: Telegram bot (mentioned in offer but v1 ships WhatsApp only, Telegram is fallback if Twilio WhatsApp approval is slow)

architecture.summary: A Netlify site collects birth data via a form, computes the chart with bodygraph-3d's engine, stores it in Supabase, and a scheduled Netlify Function runs daily to pull today's transit, generate a Hebrew message via Claude grounded in hd-atlas text, and send it over Twilio WhatsApp.

components.name: hd-atlas
components.does: Supplies Hebrew canon text for each type's Strategy and each Authority's decision-making description, used as grounding context for Claude
components.uses: local repo, packages/atlas cards read at build or function runtime via a small export script

components.name: bodygraph-3d
components.does: Computes the user's exact chart (type, Authority) from birth data and computes today's planetary transit line for the daily tip
components.uses: astronomy-engine, exposed as a small server function called from the intake and daily-send flow

components.name: Netlify
components.does: Hosts landing page, intake form, and two functions: intake-submit and daily-send (triggered by Netlify scheduled functions)
components.uses: Netlify Functions, Netlify Blobs for lightweight caching of today's transit

components.name: Supabase
components.does: Stores subscribers table (birth data, chart result, phone number, subscription status) since Netlify Functions are stateless

components.name: Twilio
components.does: Sends the daily WhatsApp message to each subscriber's number

components.name: Claude
components.does: Writes the final Hebrew daily message from a template: Strategy line + Authority tip + decision prompt, given hd-atlas text and today's transit as context
components.uses: Anthropic API called from daily-send function

components.name: Gumroad
components.does: Takes payment and captures buyer email; builder manually cross-checks paid emails against Supabase subscribers
components.uses: Gumroad product page, manual reconciliation for v1

flows.name: Onboarding
steps: User clicks WhatsApp link from landing page sample
User sends birth date, time, place as free text to the bot number
intake-submit function parses the message, calls bodygraph-3d chart function to get type + Authority
Result saved to Supabase subscribers table
Bot replies in Hebrew confirming type and Authority, links to Gumroad for payment

flows.name: Daily send
steps: Netlify scheduled function daily-send fires at 7am Israel time
For each active subscriber, function reads hd_type and hd_authority
Claude generates the Hebrew message using hd-atlas Strategy/Authority text + transit + a decision-prompt instruction
Message sent via Twilio WhatsApp API

flows.name: Payment reconciliation
steps: Gumroad sends payment notification email to rpsm90@gmail.com
Builder manually matches Gumroad buyer email to a pending subscriber phone number in Supabase
Builder updates subscriber.status to active in Supabase table editor

buildPlan.title: Landing page with sample 3-day Hebrew message
buildPlan.prompt: In ~/Documents/Projects/hd-atlas-daily-tip-hebrew-morning-author create a single static landing page (index.html, style.css) in Hebrew, RTL, with: headline, subhead, 3 benefits, a sample of 3 consecutive days of the daily WhatsApp message (write realistic Hebrew text for a Generator with Sacral Authority: Strategy line + today's Authority tip + one decision prompt, for 3 different days), and a CTA button linking to a WhatsApp click-to-chat link https://wa.me/972500000000?text=%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A6%D7%94%20%D7%9C%D7%94%D7%AA%D7%97%D7%99%D7%9C (placeholder number to be replaced once Twilio WhatsApp number is provisioned). Deploy with: cd ~/Documents/Projects/hd-atlas-daily-tip-hebrew-morning-author && npx netlify-cli deploy --prod. Print the resulting URL.
accept: netlify deploy --prod succeeds and prints a live https URL
Page renders RTL Hebrew text correctly with no broken layout on mobile width 375px
Sample messages read naturally in Hebrew and mention Strategy, Authority, and a concrete decision

buildPlan.title: Export hd-atlas Strategy/Authority text for the 5 types and 7 authorities
buildPlan.prompt: In ~/Documents/Projects/hd-atlas, inspect the existing atlas card structure first: run ls packages/atlas and cat one sample card file to see its fields. Then write a script scripts/export-strategy-authority.ts that reads all cards tagged type or authority and writes a single JSON file to ~/Documents/Projects/hd-atlas-daily-tip-hebrew-morning-author/data/strategy-authority-he.json with shape {type: string, strategy_text_he: string}[] and {authority: string, tip_text_he: string}[]. Run it with: npx tsx scripts/export-strategy-authority.ts and confirm the output file has entries for all 5 types (Generator, Manifesting Generator, Projector, Manifestor, Reflector) and at least 6 authorities.
accept: data/strategy-authority-he.json exists and is valid JSON
Contains exactly 5 type entries and at least 6 authority entries, all with non-empty Hebrew text
Running the script twice produces the same output (idempotent)

buildPlan.title: Supabase subscribers table and Netlify env wiring
buildPlan.prompt: Create a Supabase project (or use an existing one) and run this SQL in the SQL editor: create table subscribers (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), phone_e164 text unique not null, email text, birth_date date, birth_time time, birth_place text, hd_type text, hd_authority text, status text default 'trial', created_at timestamptz default now()); create table daily_message_log (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), subscriber_id uuid references subscribers(id), date date, transit_summary text, message_text text, sent_at timestamptz, twilio_sid text). In ~/Documents/Projects/hd-atlas-daily-tip-hebrew-morning-author add netlify/functions/lib/supabase.ts exporting a configured Supabase client reading SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY from process.env. Set these with: npx netlify-cli env:set SUPABASE_URL <value> and npx netlify-cli env:set SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY <value>.
accept: Both tables exist in Supabase, confirmed by running select * from subscribers limit 1 in SQL editor with no error
netlify env:list shows SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY set
A local test insert via the supabase.ts client succeeds and shows up in the table

buildPlan.title: Chart calculation function using bodygraph-3d engine
buildPlan.prompt: Inspect ~/Documents/Projects/bodygraph-3d/src to find the exported function that computes type and authority from birth date/time/place (look in src for a file exporting something like calculateBodygraph or deriveChart; run grep -r 'export function' src | grep -i chart to find it). Copy or import the minimal calculation logic into ~/Documents/Projects/hd-atlas-daily-tip-hebrew-morning-author/netlify/functions/lib/chart.ts as a function computeChart(birthDate, birthTime, birthPlace): {type: string, authority: string}. Write a small test in netlify/functions/lib/chart.test.ts using a known birth date/time and assert it returns a plausible type and authority (not 'undefined').
accept: grep command output is inspected and referenced function is correctly identified before copying
chart.test.ts passes with npx vitest run netlify/functions/lib/chart.test.ts
computeChart returns one of the 5 valid types and one of the 7 valid authorities for a test date

buildPlan.title: Intake function: WhatsApp message parses birth data and saves subscriber
buildPlan.prompt: In ~/Documents/Projects/hd-atlas-daily-tip-hebrew-morning-author create netlify/functions/intake-submit.ts as a Twilio WhatsApp webhook handler. First inspect a real Twilio incoming WhatsApp webhook payload by checking Twilio docs sample or the Twilio console log format (print the raw request body to console.log on first real test message before writing the parser). Parse free-text Hebrew birth data (expect a loose format like '15/03/1990 14:30 תל אביב'), call computeChart from lib/chart.ts, upsert into Supabase subscribers by phone_e164, and reply with a Hebrew TwiML message confirming the detected type and Authority. Deploy with npx netlify-cli deploy --prod and set the function URL as the Twilio WhatsApp webhook.
accept: Sending a test WhatsApp message with sample birth text triggers a Supabase row with correct hd_type and hd_authority
Function replies in Hebrew with the detected type and Authority within the Twilio 15-second timeout
Malformed input (missing time) returns a Hebrew error message asking to resend, not a crash

buildPlan.title: Daily-send scheduled function generating Claude-written Hebrew messages
buildPlan.prompt: In ~/Documents/Projects/hd-atlas-daily-tip-hebrew-morning-author create netlify/functions/daily-send.ts as a Netlify scheduled function (cron '0 4 * * *' for 7am Israel time UTC+3). It should: load all subscribers with status='active' from Supabase, load data/strategy-authority-he.json, call computeChart's transit helper (or a simple daily transit lookup from bodygraph-3d) to get today's transit_summary, call the Anthropic API with a Hebrew prompt template combining strategy_text_he, tip_text_he, and transit_summary asking for a short daily message with one decision prompt, send the result via Twilio WhatsApp API using TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID/TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN/TWILIO_WHATSAPP_NUMBER env vars, and log to daily_message_log. Set env vars with npx netlify-cli env:set for each. Test locally with npx netlify-cli functions:invoke daily-send.
accept: functions:invoke daily-send runs without error against at least one test subscriber in Supabase
A real WhatsApp message arrives in Hebrew with Strategy, Authority tip, and a distinct decision prompt
daily_message_log gets a new row with sent_at populated and matching twilio_sid

buildPlan.title: Gumroad product and manual reconciliation checklist
buildPlan.prompt: Create a Gumroad product 'HD Atlas יומי בעברית' with two prices: ₪19/month subscription and ₪180/year subscription. Link the Gumroad product URL in landing page CTA from T1.

docs/reconciliation.md exists with the exact SQL update command written out
Landing page CTA links to the live Gumroad product URL

launchPosts.text: מישהו כאן מרגיש שהוא יודע את הטיפוס וה-Authority שלו אבל ביום-יום פשוט שוכח להשתמש בזה? בניתי בוט וואטסאפ קטן שכל בוקר ב-7 שולח הודעה אחת בעברית: מה האסטרטגיה שלך, מה האוטוריטי אומר להיום, ועוד החלטה אמיתית לתרגל עליה. זה לא עוד אפליקציה, פשוט הודעה שנכנסת לוואטסאפ ומזכירה. אם מישהו רוצה לנסות 3 ימים בחינם, תכתבו לי בפרטי ואני אשלח לינק.

היי לכולם, מי שמכיר את הטיפוס וה-Authority שלו אבל מתקשה ליישם יום-יום — בניתי משהו פשוט: הודעת וואטסאפ אחת כל בוקר ב-7, בעברית, עם תזכורת לאסטרטגיה שלך + טיפ על האוטוריטי + החלטה אחת אמיתית ליום. מבוסס על הצ'ארט המדויק ועל השמיים של אותו יום, לא טקסט כללי. מי שרוצה לנסות, תגיבו כאן ואני שולח לינק להרשמה.

דוגמה אמיתית להודעה שתקבלו: 'בוקר טוב! היום, כ-Generator עם Sacral Authority, האנרגיה שלך מגיבה - לא יוזמת. חכה שמישהו יפנה אליך במקום לרדוף אחרי הזדמנות. נסה היום: כשמישהו יציע לך פגישה או פרויקט, שים לב אם הגוף אומר כן ברור או שקט. זו ההחלטה לתרגל.' זה בדיוק מה שנשלח כל בוקר. הלינק לניסיון בעמוד.

gtm.outreach: היי, ראיתי שאת/ה כותב/ת בקבוצת HumandesignIsrael ומכיר/ה את הטיפוס וה-Authority שלך. בניתי בוט וואטסאפ קטן שכל בוקר ב-7 שולח הודעה אחת בעברית עם תזכורת לאסטרטגיה שלך, טיפ על האוטוריטי להיום, והחלטה אמיתית לתרגל עליה - מבוסס על הצ'ארט המדויק שלך. רוצה לנסות 3 ימים בחינם? אם כן תכתוב לי את תאריך, שעה ומקום הלידה שלך ואני מפעיל לך את זה עוד היום.

judge.notes: The plan is well structured but has real unresolved blockers: unverified Twilio WhatsApp provisioning, unverified bodygraph-3d API surface, and missing payment keys despite a 'manual' reconciliation flow that still lists Gumroad/Stripe keys as needed. An agent would hit unknowns mid-build on T4-T6.
